disclaimer: Prices are Sep-2025–Aug-2026 baselines for 2 adults; Oct peak may run +10–20%. No listing photos are shown anywhere on this project by policy — where a photo is unavailable the page says so instead of using placeholders.

meta.cap_note: All-in = per night for the ROOM (2 share), incl. taxes+fees. Tier 'under2500' fits the ₹2000–2500/N filter; 'stretch' is slightly over but exceptional; 'confirm' needs a live price check before booking.
